verdict.rationale: Godot is fully open source (MIT license), can be compiled from source on any supported platform, and can be run entirely self-hosted including headless/dedicated-server mode with no cloud dependency, satisfying the core self-hosting requirement for an AI-native/open persona. missing for 10: no explicit first-party guide framed specifically as 'self-hosting for AI agents' and no independent hands-on report of someone self-hosting/building Godot specifically in an automated/AI-native pipeline.
